question: According to Isaiah 58:6, what kind of fasting has God chosen?
options: To loose the chains of injustice and set the oppressed free
To eat nothing for forty days
To fast only on feast days
To wear sackcloth and ashes every day
explanation: Isaiah 58:6 says, 'Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free?'
